tags: Premium Solid Bronze Bulldog Door Knockers

text.description_html:
Michael Healy MHCDOG14, Bulldog Front Door Knocker

Anyone who has ever owned a bulldog before, knows that once you do, you become a bulldog person. That means loving the breed and wanting others to love the english bulldog as much as you do. The Bulldog Door Knocker announces this to all your visitors right at the front door. It is made from brass and has a Oiled Bronze finish that brings out the exquisite detailing. The Premium Bulldog Door Knocker comes packaged with all the necessary mounting hardware.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Also see other Michael Healy Door Knockers

Features and Specifications of the Bulldog Door Knocker:

  • Material: Brass
  • Finish: Oiled Bronze
  • Height: 6"
  • Width: 4"
  • Projection Off Door: 3-1/2"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
